subject: Procurement kickoff: DPA signature, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list & PO routing
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@heliocloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@heliocloud.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: required privacy & PO info for activation

Hi Evelyn and Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Procurement here at HelioCloud needs a short package to complete our vendor intake so we can route a PO:

1) Executable DPA (we typically need a countersigned copy for our legal file)
2) SOC 2 Type II report or a secure link to the report (we won't accept a one-page summary)
3) Current subprocessor inventory (CSV or PDF)
4) Billing instructions and invoice remittance details + preferred PO format (we attach our PO template)

I've attached our PO template for reference (Helio_PO_Template.xlsx). Can you confirm who will sign the DPA, whether you require DocuSign, and an expected timeline for providing the SOC2 link and subprocessor roster?

We'd like to get the PO issued by next Wednesday (3/8) if possible.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Head of Vendor Operations
HelioCloud

--- attachment: Helio_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB) ---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@heliocloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: required privacy & PO info for activation

Hi Marta — great to meet you earlier.

Summary / next steps from our side:

- DPA: attaching our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf). We'll initiate signature via DocuSign unless you prefer a branded countersigned PDF. Signer on our side will be Legal (I will send the DocuSign envelope).
- SOC 2: we can't attach the full report in email for controls reasons, but here is a secure link to the latest Type II (2027): https://drive.redwood.com/soc2/report/Redwood-SOC2-Type2-2027.pdf
- Subprocessors: exporting current inventory as CSV and attaching (redwood_subprocessors_20280307.csv). It includes hosting, monitoring, and backup providers with descriptions and data access notes.
- Billing / PO: please use the PO template you sent; route to invoices@redwoodinference.com. Our AP contact for questions is Laura Bennett (cc'd).

Please see attachments and the DocuSign link we'll send in a follow-up reply. If you need the DPA redlined, send proposed edits and we'll route to Legal for a rapid review — typical turnaround is 48–72 hours for limited changes.

Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--- attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB), redwood_subprocessors_20280307.csv (text/csv, 10 KB) ---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@heliocloud.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: required privacy & PO info for activation

Hi Marta — quick technical note as you review the SOC2 link and subprocessors:

- SOC2 scope: the report covers our hosted inference control plane and production-serving runtime for the 2027 audit period. It excludes model artifacts created/ingested by customers.
- Subprocessors list: the CSV flags any vendor with potential access to customer metadata. If you want a formal attestation on access scopes for a specific subprocessor, tell us which vendor and we can pull the access matrix.

If HelioCloud requires any compensating controls for a specific subprocessor, please flag and we'll coordinate mitigation or an exception.

-Rishi
Applied ML / Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

Hi Marta — following up to confirm the intake path and next milestones.

1) DPA signing: DocuSign envelope sent to procure@heliocloud.com (envelope ID: 0TAB123456789). Please complete signature on your side; I'll notify Legal once countersigned.
2) PO ingestion: once you issue a PO, please email a scan/attachment to invoices@redwoodinference.com and include the HelioCloud PO number in the subject line. Our AP will create a vendor invoice route and confirm Net30 terms as a default.
3) Billing contact: invoices@redwoodinference.com (AP team). If you prefer a specific billing contact for the first invoice, paste the contact and we'll add them to the vendor record.
4) Go-live timing: assuming DPA + PO complete by 3/10, we can enable provisioned access by 3/13. Let us know if HelioCloud needs an earlier activation window and we'll prioritize.

HubSpot reference: deal HD-2345. I will log PO receipt against that record.

Thanks — talk soon.

Laura Bennett
Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
